threads.body: [Testing] This shared replacement also runs under the Java agent, but the new library suite covers only delays and dispatcher hops. The existing agent `/child` fixture likewise covers only a dispatcher hop, leaving the external-job suspension behavior this PR promises to preserve untested. Add an agent-backed regression that actually suspends while awaiting a job launched in a separate coroutine scope. Run it on baseline Ktor 3 and 3.4.3+, and verify the active request span after resumption and independent exported traces across successive requests.
